title: Discuss your project
description: Plan bespoke leather and wood accessories with SFP. Contact our team in Berlin.

title.html: Every project starts with a conversation.

body.html: A clear idea or an open question: tell us what you have in mind. We’ll help you prepare a concise project brief.
Our products and services are available exclusively to business customers.
Your brief is prepared here in your browser. You then open the email draft and send it through your email app. You can also copy or download the brief.
Production can take 4–6 weeks after your approval. We agree the specific delivery date with you.
Where the product, materials and capacity allow, express orders are available for a surcharge, with delivery potentially in under two weeks. We confirm feasibility before you place the order.
For new customers, we request 100% payment in advance. For large orders from existing customers, we request a 50% advance payment. The agreed terms are set out in your quotation.
